title: Composition of normalized unshifted rational Tate-line comparisons
statement: Let $\ell,p$ be primes, let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p$ with $p\ne\ell$, and let $Y$ be a scheme over $\operatorname{Spec}k$. For a finite intermediate field index $c$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ or the algebraic-closure index, use the coefficient ring $\Lambda$, rational Tate lines $L_X$, self-product $W=\mathbf P^1_Y\times_Y\mathbf P^1_Y$, projections $p_1,p_2$, and specified maps of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pretrace-data]. Put $q:\mathbf P^1_Y\to Y$ and $T=L_{\mathbf P^1_Y}[2]$, where the line is first placed in complex degree zero. The forward scalar exchange $\operatorname{secondTraceExchange}:q^*Rq_*T\to Rp_{2*}L_W[2]$ is exactly the component $\operatorname{condensedAmbientExchange}_T:q^*Rq_*T\to Rp_{2*}p_1^*T$ followed by $Rp_{2*}(\operatorname{firstLineComparisonForTrace}.\mathrm{hom})$. Thus the proposition $\operatorname{ScalarTraceWitness}(\ell,c,k,p,p\ne\ell,Y)$ is inhabited. This is the defining exchange equality; it does not assert composition of the unshifted line comparisons.

proof.text: Use the existing fixed-endpoint native-exchange wrapper secondPretraceExchangeMap on the right-hand side of ScalarTraceWitness.exchange_eq. This wrapper unfolds to exactly condensedAmbientExchange.app after unfolding the derived pullback/pushforward aliases, so it preserves the original equation. Construct the exchange_eq field, unfold only secondTraceExchange, and close by reflexivity: its definition is that same wrapper followed by the pushforward of firstLineComparisonForTrace.hom. No native derived functor or coefficient construction is expanded at the specialized rational line.
